sequence.subject: Congrats on joining Ramp — AI agents in production question
sequence.body:
Congrats on joining Ramp — 'Agents at Work Today' on the homepage makes the engineering mandate pretty clear.

We build production AI automation systems for fintech companies — the kind running behind the expense coding, receipt matching, and accounting automation Ramp ships. We've delivered fraud detection at 0.80 recall and full-stack AI apps for financial clients.

Happy to share what's working and what breaks in production, if that's useful context as you're getting oriented.

15 minutes this week?

sequence.message: Sent a note about Ramp's AI agent stack. We build production AI systems for fintech — the engineering behind expense automation and LLM-in-production. Worth a quick chat if you're evaluating the external build ecosystem.

sequence.subject: RE: Congrats on joining Ramp — AI agents in production question
sequence.body:
One thing that might be relevant: we shipped `CrabTrap` equivalent work before Brex open-sourced theirs — LLM-as-a-judge patterns to secure AI agents in production. Brex published theirs in April (611 GitHub stars already).

Ramp and Brex are running the same race on AI-native spend management. If there are specific production AI system challenges where an outside engineering team would accelerate delivery, that's the 15 minutes worth having.

Muhammed John, Axiora
